text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm searching the school for Tazuna,
thinking it
might be nice to invite her
out, when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you listening?! We must handle this posthaste!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Personal space! Our faces are almost
touching,
Tazuna!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear an uncharacteristically angry—yet

familiar—voice from around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurry over to see what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my manners, but this is a serious
situation,
Director Akikawa!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Academy infirmary is an
important
lifeline for our Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But it can't fulfill that role if it isn't fully

equipped. Running out of essential
equipment is
unacceptable!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I wholeheartedly agree with you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, the fact that there was an
accident
during shipping is out of our
control! I've already
arranged for a new
delive—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But a delivery later is no use to students
who
need the facilities today! Surely—

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Silence!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Tazuna. Yes, the shipment
has been
delayed, but we still have
ample supplies in
reserve.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The students will get nervous if they see
you
acting like this. For their sakes, I
suggest you take
a walk to cool down.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
M-my apologies... Yes, that... sounds like
a good
idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna trudges away, and I rush after
her.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Did you happen to... witness that just
now?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... How embarrassing. I lost my
composure
back there.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've seen all kinds of racers here at
Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, some do amazing in the
Twinkle Series
and then go on to the
Dream Trophy League,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are only a few racers like that.
Most aren't
so lucky.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Many lose the ability to perform at their
best,
either due to injury or accident.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Most of our students love running so
much that
they've dedicated their lives
to it by coming here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So the despair they feel when they find
out they'll
never feel the wind in their
faces again...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It's absolutely dreadful...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Tazuna falls silent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we stand there, we can hear students
training
in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I'm cooled off now!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'd better get back to work.
Sorry for
worrying you! I'll—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry... I just tripped, that's all. How
clumsy of
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she puts on a smile, it's clear her
ankle is
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No, that's not necessary! Really!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her protests, I treat Tazuna's
ankle with
the medical equipment I
always have on me.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you... As expected, your first
aid skills
are exemplary...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It feels very... reassuring having you
around,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I might even be a little jealous of your
trainee...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, that was a joke! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking care of me! If it's
all right,
I'd like to repay the favor.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So let's go out for a meal again. On me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tazuna and I decide to go to
our usual
ramen spot.
